scenes.hook: H T M L Div vs Span. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Div and span are generic containers for grouping content. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: A div is block level by default; a span is inline. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: Use a span to group words within a line of text. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Prefer a meaningful semantic element when one fits your content. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Wrap a sentence in a div and one word in a span. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
